symptom: A flow call's return value mappings (Mendix 11.5 Forms$OutputMapping, Studio Pro's "Return value mappings") had no MDL: describe printed nothing, describe → exec of a Studio Pro page dropped every mapping (Replaced page, mx check silent), and a script could not write one. The stopgap carry (canon.CarryOutputMappings) kept them through a rewrite but also restored mappings a script had deliberately removed
cause: No syntax and, until ako/TestApp Pages.OutputMappingButton (Studio Pro 11.15), no measured shape to write — so the rebuild wrote the empty list
file: mdl/grammar/domains/MDLPage.g4 (actionReturnsV3), mdl/visitor/visitor_page_v3.go (buildActionReturnsV3), mdl/executor/page_flow_returns.go (applyFlowReturns, storedFlowReturns), mdl/executor/version_gates.go (flowReturnsGates), mdl/backend/modelsdk/widget_write.go (outputMappingToGen, Forms$OutputMapping defaults), sdk/versions/mendix-11.yaml (flow_call_output_mappings 11.5, _to_attribute 11.15); carry removed from modelsdk/canon
insight: Studio Pro's slot names lie: SourceVariable is the TARGET page variable, and the return value itself fills no source slot (AttributeRef/SourceAttributeRef/Expression/SourceVariable map to 3 measured row kinds). A carry is a stopgap that must go when syntax lands, or a statement that omits the clause gets the stored mappings back — the control that proves it is 'remove one returns clause, count drops by one'. The metamodel floor (outputMappings introduced 11.5.0) was not the whole floor: the identical bytes fail CE7006 on mx 11.13.0 and 11.14.0 and pass on 11.15.0-rc.4, before and after `mx convert`, while a page-variable target passes on all three — measure per target kind with `mx convert -p -s` to the next version rather than trusting the introduction version. The Studio Pro sample itself crashed mx 11.15 check (NullReferenceException in OutputMappingUtils.Check) because its nanoflow call names no nanoflow (#1728); wire a real flow into a scratch copy before using such a page as a control. Gate in statementVersionGates as well as the builder, or check -p passes what exec refuses (#1434)
